scope: Removal of redundant Mix/Clips/Postari sub-tabs below Stories

changes.summary: Added Tweets as the final Social feed switcher option, mapped it to socialTopView=tweets and socialFormat=tweets, and removed rendered data-format sub-tabs from renderPulse.
Filtered format=tweets to text-only posts without attached media.
Hid the old feedTabs surface and expanded .pulsePosts/.clipVisual height so content starts directly after Stories.
Added static assertions for Tweets feed, text-only backend filtering and removal of data-format sub-tabs.

notes: Camera action calls openComposer('post', { camera: true }). On insecure local HTTP mobile browsers it falls back to native capture picker with capture=environment.
Gallery action calls openComposer('post', { pick: 'all' }) and opens the native image/video file picker directly.
Story action calls openComposer('story', { pick: 'all' }) and opens story composer with media picker.

runtime_note: If the existing local server process does not hot-reload backend files, /api/social/feed?format=tweets requires a safe server restart to load api.js/repo.js changes. Static UI social36 is live immediately.
